listenings.text: Oh, good morning! Yes, I had a very nice weekend, thank you. On Saturday, my husband and I went to the mountains. We took the train at seven in the morning, and we walked for five hours. It was cold, but the view was beautiful. We came back very tired. On Sunday, we didn't go out. We stayed at home, we cooked, and we watched a film. It was a quiet day, and I needed it. And you, Fernanda? How was your weekend?

Hello, everyone. Yes, I am back. In China, the first week of October is a holiday. We call it Golden Week. I went to my hometown to see my parents. I took the fast train. It was about six hours, and the train was very full, because everybody travels in this week. My mother cooked every day, and I ate too much. I also saw some old friends from school. I got back on Sunday night. I brought some tea for the team, so when you visit the plant, you can try it.
